components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action; accent fill, uppercase tracked label on CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: var(--accent, #8ab4ff); color: var(--accent-foreground, #0a0a0b); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8ab4ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2e2e33); border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #f5f5f4); font-weight: 500; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #1c1c1f); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8ab4ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill tag, for example the availability badge.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #8ab4ff); color: var(--accent-foreground, #0a0a0b); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Header Pill
components.description: Floating glass pill with logo and controls; the only use of backdrop blur.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 8px 8px 20px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--border, #2e2e33) 60%, transparent); border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--background, #0a0a0b) 60%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px) saturate(1.5); color: var(--foreground, #f5f5f4); } .ds-logo { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-cta { height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent, #8ab4ff); color: var(--accent-foreground, #0a0a0b); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #8ab4ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Surface one tone above background with hairline border, flat at rest.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2e2e33); border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: var(--surface, #141416); color: var(--surface-foreground, #f5f5f4); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground, #a1a1aa); line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a well-made instrument: precise, restrained, and responsive to touch. Surfaces stay calm so the engineering work carries the page. One accent per theme marks what matters; motion and sound exist as controlled feedback, never as decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One accent per theme, never a second hue.
Tonal layering and hairline borders instead of shadows.
Pill-soft, confident controls; square in Swiss.
Large, tightly tracked Geist display type over calm body text.
Motion (GSAP) and sound are optional layers; sound is muted by default.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Each theme has exactly one accent. It marks actions, focus and a few key moments; if everything is accented, nothing is.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: Components read semantic tokens, never raw hex. A new theme must work by changing token values alone.

rules.name: The Fluid Scale Rule
rules.body: Sizes come from the --text-* clamp scale. No fixed px type and no per-breakpoint overrides.

rules.name: The Glass Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur belongs to the header pill alone.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (bg-accent, text-muted-foreground, border-border) so all three themes work.
Do use the fluid --text-*, --gutter and --section-space scales.
Do keep the 2px accent focus ring on every interactive element.
Do time motion with the duration and ease tokens, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep sound muted until the visitor opts in.
donts: Don't add a second accent hue or hard-code hex in components.
Don't use shadows for routine depth or glass outside the header.
Don't use any animation library other than GSAP.
Don't hide essential controls behind hover on touch screens.
Don't use rounded corners in the Swiss theme.
